questions.question: What kind of psalm is Psalm 45?
How is the king addressed in a striking verse?
options: 'Give the king your justice, O God'
'The LORD reigns; let the earth rejoice'
'Your throne, O God, is forever and ever'
'Blessed is the king who comes in the name of the LORD'
questions.answer: 'Your throne, O God, is forever and ever'
